acceptance_criteria.criterion: Opening the app in a browser navigates to #/ and renders the dashboard view by default.
The dashboard fetches projects from GET /api/projects and displays each project with its ID/name, repository count (Repositories.length), and workspace count.
Each project entry links to #/projects/:id and clicking it triggers a hash navigation without page reload.

The 'Create Project' button shows a form with name (required) and description (optional) fields, submits via api.projects.create(), and refreshes the project list on success or shows an error toast on failure.

All five routes listed in the plan are registered in app.js: #/ (dashboard), #/repositories, #/projects/:id, #/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid, #/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/branch-switch — unimplemented views show placeholder content.
The router starts automatically on page load via router.start() and responds to hashchange events.
